title: Clock and time (use_sim_time)
keywords: time clock sim_time use_sim_time simulation simulated wall bag gazebo
text: With use_sim_time set to true, a node takes its time from the /clock topic, published by a simulator or by ros2 bag play --clock, instead of the system clock. All nodes of a system must agree: mixing simulated and wall time causes TF extrapolation errors, timers that never fire and messages dropped as too old. ros2 param get /node use_sim_time shows what a node uses.
